Got a nosebleed? Don't tilt your head back. The blood just runs down your throat.
Most nosebleeds start at the front of the nose, where tiny blood vessels sit right under the surface.
Lean forward, pinch the soft part of your nose, and hold for ten to fifteen minutes. A cold pack helps too.
Still bleeding after fifteen minutes, or after a knock to the head? Get medical help. Otherwise... you've got this.
